text: API agreed with Studio 2026-09-25 (same spec file). TrialKey = participant+phase+trial(+occurrence) with a separate match-item attribute and conflict check; MatchedReferences RequireOne (default) | SameOccurrence | Select(First|Last|Occurrence(n)) | MeanOfAll (explicitly labelled); control pool applies the same selection by default (all-occurrence controls is a named option); UnmatchedFocal ReportNoMatch (default) | Refuse. One MatchedCardinality value drives preflight, run refusal, preview. Owner to confirm the control-pool default and off-screen quarantine.
